Elevate your workspace with the architectural precision of our handcrafted Hexagonal Sabai Grass Organiser. Designed for the sophisticated executive, this artisanal piece combines organic textures with "slow luxury" durability. Perfect for the woman who demands both power and sustainability in her office decor.

Materials: 100% Eco-friendly Sabai Grass.
Design: Signature hexagonal silhouette with natural green-weave accents.

Discover the perfect blend of style and sustainability with our eco-friendly straw crossbody sling bag. Handcrafted with care, this beautiful and elegant accessory complements any outfit while promoting sustainable fashion. Lightweight and durable, it's the ideal choice for eco-conscious shoppers. Elevate your style effortlessly with this versatile bag, perfect for daily use or special occasions.
